business_model.basis: Stated directly in 10-K Item 1 and 10-Q MD&A.
business_model.claim: Slide is a coastal specialty property and casualty insurer that writes single family, condominium, and commercial residential policies in coastal states along the Atlantic seaboard.
quotes: We focus on profitable underwriting of single family, condominium and commercial residential policies in the property and casualty (P&C) industry in coastal states along the Atlantic seaboard through our insurance subsidiary, Slide Insurance Company ("SIC").

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K Item 7 MD&A overview table.
business_model.claim: The company operates as a single reportable segment.
quotes: We have one reportable segment.

business_model.claim: Gross premiums written are the primary revenue driver, composed of assumed premiums from Citizens policy take-outs, direct premiums from renewals of Citizens policies, new and renewal policies written through independent agents and the DTC channel, and block acquisitions from third-party insurers.
quotes: Gross premiums written represent, with respect to a fiscal period, the sum of assumed premiums written from Citizens policy assumptions (net of opt-outs) plus direct premiums written (premiums from subsequent renewals of such Citizens policies and new and renewal policies written through independent agents and our DTC channel, net of any midterm cancellations), in each case prior to amounts ceded to reinsurers.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K MD&A and shown in 10-Q income statement.
business_model.claim: Net investment income is a secondary revenue line, earned on cash, fixed-maturity securities, money market accounts, and other investments.
quotes: Net investment income represents interest earned from cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash, fixed-maturity securities, money market accounts and other investments and the realized gains or losses from the sale of investments.

business_model.claim: Florida law allows a $25 policy fee on each policy written, recognized immediately as income when the policy is issued.
quotes: Florida law allows insurers to charge policyholders a $25 policy fee on each policy written. Policy fees represent such upfront policy fees. These fees are not subject to refund, and accordingly we recognize policy fees as income immediately when collected in accordance with ASC 606, which coincides with the completion of our service obligation when the policy is issued.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K MD&A and shown in 10-Q income statement.
business_model.claim: Losses and loss adjustment expenses (LAE) incurred, net, are the largest expense line, reflecting paid claims, claim resolution costs, and changes in unpaid loss reserves (including IBNR), net of reinsurance recoveries.
quotes: Losses and loss adjustment expenses incurred, net reflect losses paid, expenses paid to resolve claims, such as fees paid to adjusters, attorneys and investigators, and changes in our reserves for unpaid losses and loss adjustment expenses incurred, net during the fiscal period, in each case net of losses ceded to reinsurers.

business_model.claim: Reinsurance premiums paid to reinsurers are the company's single largest cost, and ceded premiums earned are deducted from gross premiums to arrive at net premiums earned.
quotes: Reinsurance is an important part of our risk management strategy and premiums paid to reinsurers is our single largest cost.

business_model.claim: Policy acquisition and other underwriting expenses consist of commissions to outside agents, premium taxes, and inspection fees, recognized ratably over the policy term.
quotes: Policy acquisition and other underwriting expenses consist of the following items: (i) commissions paid to outside agents at the time of policy issuance, (ii) premium taxes and (iii) inspection fees. We recognize policy acquisition and other underwriting expenses ratably over the term of the underlying policy.

business_model.claim: General and administrative expenses include compensation and benefits, professional fees, office lease, information system expenses, and corporate insurance, and grew with headcount to support increased policies in force.
quotes: General and administrative expenses include compensation and related benefits, professional fees, office lease and related expenses, information system expenses, corporate insurance, and other general and administrative costs.

business_model.claim: The company distributes policies through two channels: independent agents and a direct-to-consumer (DTC) channel, with the agent channel currently dominant.
quotes: We market and write insurance policies through two channels: our independent agents and DTC. We are an agency-focused company and pride ourselves on our ability to provide superior customer service to both our agents and policyholders.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K Item 1 (Technology and Underwriting sections).
business_model.claim: The company's proprietary technology platform, built on an approximately $8.9 trillion TIV underwriting and claims dataset, is used to estimate forward-looking reinsurance costs at the policy level and select only policies expected to be profitable.
quotes: Our underwriting technology has been an important component of our success and is backed by our proprietary approximately $8.9 trillion TIV underwriting and claims dataset, which provides us with real-time intelligence to drive superior decision making.

business_model.basis: Stated in 10-K MD&A, 10-Q MD&A, and Q3 2026 earnings release.
business_model.claim: The combined ratio (loss ratio plus expense ratio) is the key underwriting profitability metric; a ratio below 100% indicates underwriting profit.
quotes: Combined ratio is the sum of the loss ratio and the expense ratio. A combined ratio under 100% indicates an underwriting profit. A combined ratio over 100% indicates an underwriting loss.

competitive_position.basis: Stated directly in the 10-K Item 1 Business section and repeated in the 10-Q MD&A.
competitive_position.claim: Slide positions itself as a technology-enabled coastal specialty insurer targeting underserved markets along the Atlantic seaboard, focusing on single-family, condominium, and commercial residential P&C policies.
quotes: Launched in 2021, we are a technology enabled, fast-growing, coastal specialty insurer.

We focus on profitable underwriting of single family, condominium and commercial residential policies in the property and casualty (P&C) industry in coastal states along the Atlantic seaboard through our insurance subsidiary, Slide Insurance Company ("SIC").

our proprietary approximately $8.9 trillion TIV underwriting and claims dataset, which provides us with real-time intelligence to drive superior decision making.

competitive_position.basis: Stated as a risk factor in the 10-K; no specific competitor names or market-share data are provided.
competitive_position.claim: Slide faces competition from larger insurers with substantially greater financial resources, higher ratings, broader agency networks, and bundled-product capabilities, as well as emerging technology-driven entrants in adjacent categories.
quotes: Some of our competitors have substantially greater financial resources, higher financial ratings, greater name recognition, broader access to capital, more extensive agency networks, and the ability to offer bundled products.

We also face emerging competition from technology-driven companies and entrants that have begun operating in adjacent insurance categories and may expand into homeowners and commercial residential products, potentially offering more competitive pricing, innovative distribution, or advanced claims processing capabilities that could erode any advantages we have developed through our technology platform.

competitive_position.claim: Slide does not hold an A.M. Best financial strength rating, which may limit its ability to compete with larger, rated carriers and could affect customer and counterparty confidence.

risks.claim: Slide's insurance subsidiaries lack an AM Best rating, which the company acknowledges may limit its ability to expand business and access credit, and a downgrade of its Demotech rating could trigger regulatory scrutiny.
quotes: We do not currently have a rating from AM Best Company, a U.S.-based credit rating agency ('AM Best'). It is possible that some prospective customers may be reluctant to do business with a company that is not rated by AM Best and not having an AM Best rating may prevent us from expanding our business or limit our access to credit from certain financial institutions, which may in turn limit our ability to compete with large, national insurance companies and certain regional insurance companies.

A significant downgrade could trigger regulatory scrutiny or intervention, potentially leading to supervision, rehabilitation, or liquidation proceedings for the insurance carrier subsidiary, which would have a severe adverse impact on our results of operations, financial condition, and ability to continue as a going concern.
